citeAs: Gao, J., Gan, L., Li, Y., Ye, Y., and Wang, D. (2024). Dissecting Dissonance: Benchmarking Large Multimodal Models Against Self-Contradictory Instructions. arXiv.
creator: Jin Gao, Lei Gan, Yuankai Li, Yixin Ye, Dequan Wang (Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Fudan University; Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory)
description: A multimodal benchmark for evaluating large multimodal models' ability to detect self-contradictory instructions. It contains 20,000 conflicts evenly distributed between language-language and vision-language paradigms across 8 tasks, and was constructed using the automatic dataset creation framework AutoCreate.
name: Self-Contradictory Instructions (SCI)
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The paper states that both human experts and LLMs are involved in double-checking the quality of the generated dataset, and that human experts rigorously checked the quality of the AutoCreate-generated dataset. For evaluation of model replies, the paper also reports alignment between LLM evaluation agents and human experts using Spearman correlation and concordance rate.
rai:dataBiases: The paper states that AutoCreate allows integration of extensive knowledge and that the framework facilitates creation of diverse instruction datasets, promoting inclusivity in AI research. It also notes that only SemanticConflict involves external data from ImageNet, which is a design decision affecting data sources across tasks.
rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created with AutoCreate, an automatic dataset creation framework that starts from a small batch of manually input seeds and iteratively expands a seed pool through two loops: a language loop and a visual loop. In each cycle, a Generator creates initial language or vision data, a Decorator introduces self-contradictions, and a Cleaner removes data that does not meet quality standards; both human experts and LLMs double-check quality, and refined outputs are fed back into the seed pool.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Raw inputs include manually input task-relevant seeds in a seed pool, generated text and images from the AutoCreate framework, and for SemanticConflict, external data from the ImageNet dataset and images retrieved from the ImageNet-1k validation set.
rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator, Software Collection, Others
rai:dataLimitations: The paper notes that SCI currently includes only language-language and vision-language paradigms, with more modalities planned in the future. It also states that no fine-grained control is introduced to determine conflict degree, and it does not provide a detailed study on the attention mechanism of large multimodal models when confronted with conflict instructions.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The dataset is post-processed by deliberately introducing contradictions through a Decorator stage. Examples include generating violating sentences against rules, producing opposite attribute descriptions, pairing mutually exclusive instructions, selecting forbidden words and questions that require them, modifying image captions for V-L conflicts, changing maximum values to minimum values in chart data, altering object descriptions to refer to non-existent geometric objects, and substituting correct class labels in ImageNet-based questions with similar but different objects.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: AutoCreate includes a Cleaner that removes data that does not meet quality standards, and the resulting high-quality dataset is refined to extract new seeds for re-entry into the seed pool. For different tasks, preprocessing/manipulation includes modifying image captions to introduce conflicts in V-L tasks, and manual selection of SCI-Base and SCI-Core subsets from SCI-All.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper states that SCI provides researchers and practitioners with a standardized platform to assess and enhance LMMs' ability to navigate conflicting instructions, advancing human-computer interaction and communication technologies. It also says AutoCreate facilitates creation of diverse instruction datasets, promoting inclusivity in AI research, and that improving dissonance detection can boost trust and reliability in AI systems for societal integration.
rai:dataUseCases: The benchmark is intended to evaluate and analyze large multimodal models' ability to recognize and handle self-contradictory instructions in both language-language and vision-language settings, and to facilitate qualitative evaluation through SCI-Core, SCI-Base, and SCI-All splits.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: Large language models are used throughout the automatic dataset creation and quality-control pipeline. The paper states that AutoCreate leverages LLMs to generate data, extract attributes, generate contradictory sentences, judge question uniqueness, and double-check dataset quality; GPT-4 is also used as an evaluation agent in experiments.
